name: ANSI four-way switch plan symbol
summary: US plan symbol S4 for a four-way switch placed between two three-way switches to add control points.
description: The S4 symbol marks a four-way switch, which crosses the travellers between two three-way switches. Any number of S4 switches can be added along the travellers, so long corridors and rooms with several entries show S3 at the ends and S4 between.
Reading the plan, the installer checks that S4 never appears without a pair of S3 switches on the same group. The IEC equivalent is the intermediate switch.
The symbol gives no information about the device rating or style. Smart switching systems may replace this wiring scheme with a master and companion device, which should be noted.
readingNotes: Confirm two S3 switches exist on the same group.
Watch for smart-switch notes that change the wiring scheme.
distinction: S3 changes over; S4 crosses two travellers and only works between S3 switches.
